decisive_items: follicular thyroid cells in the goiter and the manubrial lesion
thyroid follicles infiltrating adjacent to bone trabeculae
response.rationale: Lytic bone lesion with thyroid follicular cells and histologic infiltration of bone trabeculae indicates metastatic thyroid tissue, not simple recurrent goiter.

rejected.why: Residual goiter explains thyroid tissue in neck but not the destructive manubrial bone lesion with follicular cells.
